  obfuscation.structural_payload  [HIGH]  DETECTION
    Inference   : Decoded/decompressed content from one or more obfuscation layers structurally validates as a PE image.
    Confidence  : high  —  Unlike raw entropy/Base64/GZIP presence, this checks WHAT the decoded bytes actually are: full PE structural validation (DOS/COFF/optional header + complete section table). Encoding was only the delivery mechanism here — the payload itself is the evidence.
    Facts:
      - type=PE encoding=base64 container_VA=0x300000 module_status=UNREGISTERED decoded_size=1184
    Limitations:
      - Structural validation reduces but does not eliminate false positives from adversarially-crafted or coincidental byte sequences in high-entropy data.

  [ VERDICT ]  LIKELY — one structural indicator (sleep-mask decode or PE payload)  (1/2 — structural detections only; entropy/Base64/GZIP/shellcode-prefix are observations/leads, never a verdict by themselves)
